## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Client-side only: no servers, network requests, analytics or cookies
- [ ] User-facing text goes through the translation files
- [ ] Accessible: keyboard, screen readers, contrast, dark mode
- [ ] New dependencies are justified in the commit message
